error.title: Render graph not ready for farm
error.description:
## Render graph is not ready for farm rendering
The Movie Render Graph **{graph_name}** used by this render doesn't let AYON choose where the frames are saved. Without it, the farm would save the frames to a place the publish can't find.
### How to repair?
Use **Show Render Graph** to find the graph, open it and fix:
{problems}
Then save the graph, check it in to version control and publish again.
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__ (optional)
Farm renders are saved to the AYON work directory. AYON sets the location for each render job with these graph variables, the graph itself is not changed:
- `{output_directory_variable}` (DirectoryPath or String) connected to **Output Directory** of the **Global Output Settings** node in the *Globals* branch. - `{file_name_format_variable}` (String) connected to **File Name Format** of every image sequence output node (e.g. **EXR Sequence**).
At least one image sequence output node must save **.{render_format}** images, the render format set in AYON project settings.
A property can be connected to a variable only after its override checkbox is enabled and it is promoted to a pin (right click the property and choose **Promote Property to Pin**). Only nodes of the graph itself are checked, nodes inside subgraphs are not used.
